mapper.select: SELECT c.id as course_id, c.name as course_name, i.id as instructor_id, i.name as instructor_name, i.email as instructor_mail, s.id as student_id, s.name as student_name, s.age as student_age, s.gender as student_gender, s.course as student_course FROM Course c LEFT JOIN Instructor i ON c.instructor_id = i.id LEFT JOIN Student s ON c.id = s.course_id WHERE c.id = #{courseId}

SELECT c.id as course_id, c.name as course_name, i.id as instructor_id, i.name as instructor_name, i.email as instructor_mail, s.id as student_id, s.name as student_name, s.age as student_age, s.gender as student_gender, s.course as student_course FROM Course c LEFT JOIN Instructor i ON c.instructor_id = i.id LEFT JOIN Student s ON c.id = s.course_id ORDER BY c.id
